description: eugr's (Eugene Rakhmatulin) spark-vllm-docker 4x-spark-cluster deepseek-v4.1-flash recipe for DeepSeek's official DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash (plain V4.1, not the 1017 build; checkpoint revision 314113f8), MIT, served by vLLM on four Sparks with tensor parallelism 4. Runs eugr's published vllm-node-b12x image (nightly-20261102, `--exp-b12x` lane, digest pinned, built from spark-vllm-docker b7f6b4cd) with upstream's launch: bfloat16, B12X linear, MoE and attention backends, block size 256, prefix caching, DSpark speculative decoding with 7 tokens (probabilistic draft sampling, adaptive verification, draft tensor parallelism 4), the deepseek_v41 reasoning and tool-call parsers, one image per prompt, two sequences, 4,096 batched tokens and memory utilisation 0.87; RoCE all-reduce environment as upstream. Upstream sets max-model-len to `auto`; this recipe binds the context setting instead (1,048,576 tokens, the checkpoint's 1M-token design length; the pool-less 0.87 budget is expected to hold one such request). Memory: the checkpoint is 510 GB, of which two Engram shards (47 and 48, about 203 GB) are read from disk row by row, which upstream does through b12x's io_uring reader. The workload sandbox blocks io_uring, so the image installs the POSIX pread transport that the 0xSero DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash adapter uses (the same _ple_reader.c, copied byte for byte over b12x's loader file) and the checkpoint loader is switched from `b12x` to `safetensors` by the launcher; B12X attention, MoE and linear kernels stay. Both are interface fixes, and whether that file fits the b12x build inside eugr's image is untested: the hardware try decides. Per-rank estimate before the first try: the non-Engram weights are about 307 GB, 76.8 GB per Spark, plus a KV pool inside the 0.87 budget (113.7 GB) and 8 GB overhead (loading floor about 84.8 GB, predicted to fit). The declared peak is that budget plus the 10.4 GB multi-Spark margin used for pool-less vLLM (124.1 GB), which the offline admission estimate treats as borderline for an idle Spark; the hardware try measures the real use. This is an offline estimate. Upstream's recipe is cluster-only. No upstream performance claims are recorded. Upstream repository MIT.
title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash B12X DSpark vLLM four Sparks (eugr)
